messages.assets.opening.purpose: Introduce Port Azure, the approaching storm, and the shared recovery mission.
messages.assets.opening.script: Port Azure has weathered generations of storms, but tonight every district faces the same horizon. Rain is strengthening. Transport routes are narrowing. Critical services are under pressure. Across the city, responders and residents are preparing together. Your unit is joining Mission Control to turn uncertain reports into grounded decisions, connect specialist work, and restore essential services safely. Evidence will change. Tools may fail. Resources are finite. Coordinate clearly, verify before acting, and keep people at the center of every decision. The storm is approaching. The lighthouse is still shining. Your mission begins now.
messages.assets.opening.pronunciation: Port Azure: port AZH-er. Maya Chen: MY-uh chen. Jules Martin: zhool mar-TAN.
messages.assets.opening.accessibility: Provide synchronized captions, clear narration over restrained ambience, and meaningful visual descriptions in the transcript.
